tools.name: exec

tools.description: Download a file

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Writes atomically and creates parent directories. URL-encode the absolute Windows path. Body is bytes, not JSON.

tools.name: fork
tools.description: Protected computers refuse cloning. Partial failures return the snapshot and all copies that started; retain their IDs before retrying.

tools.name: input
tools.description: Coordinates are screenshot pixels. Scroll dy is notches, positive down. Body limit 64 KiB. Inspect the screen before repeating uncertain input.

tools.name: key_create

tools.name: key_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an API key

tools.name: keys
tools.description: List API keys

tools.name: machine_create
tools.description: Persist a unique Idempotency-Key and exact body before calling. require_office_ready rejects an unverified template before provisioning. Creation needs 15 minutes of resulting aggregate running credit and capacity. prevent_cloning protects the new identity.

tools.name: machine_delete
tools.description: Irreversible. Backups are deleted too. Snapshots and forks retain their own state and encryption keys.

tools.name: machine_get
tools.description: Read a computer

tools.name: machine_health
tools.description: Read guest readiness

tools.name: machine_request
tools.description: Read-only request-key lookup; never creates another computer.

tools.name: machine_request_stop
tools.description: Cancels the request key before locating/stopping a possibly created computer. A cancelled key cannot be reused.

tools.name: machine_start
tools.description: Read stop_warning/resume_warning before continuing work. A cold recovery can preserve disk without unsaved memory. New admission requires prepaid runway and physical capacity.

tools.name: machine_stop
tools.description: Read stop_warning/resume_warning before continuing work. A cold recovery can preserve disk without unsaved memory. Stop ends running charges; optional stopped storage/backups retain their rates.

tools.name: machine_update
tools.description: Change auto-stop or backup settings

tools.description: List kept computers

tools.description: Available prepayment methods and amount bounds

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Read a PNG of the desktop

tools.name: service_health
tools.description: Control-plane health

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Creates an account or recovers access through an API-readable inbox. Codes expire in 10 minutes, with five attempts. The provider code is never returned. Limit: three requests per address, replenishing one per minute.

tools.name: signup_verify
tools.description: Consumes one email code. Only an active single-organization administrator may recover an account key. The key is shown once; a lost reply requires another email challenge. No free credit.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot memory and disk

tools.description: Start a copy from a snapshot

tools.name: template_create
tools.description: Replaces the source computer. Private templates copy files and signed-in identities; remove credentials before saving. Protected computers refuse this operation.

tools.name: template_delete
tools.description: Erase a private template

tools.name: templates
tools.description: List shared and private templates

tools.name: topup_pay
tools.description: Use one payment header and keep Authorization for the Panes key. Missing payment returns 402 with WWW-Authenticate (MPP) or PAYMENT-REQUIRED (x402) and payment in the JSON body. Stripe SPT payload is {spt,externalId}; x402 v2 payload includes resource, accepted requirements, signature and EIP-3009 a

tools.name: topup_quote
tools.description: Reusing a key returns the original quote (HTTP 200); a changed amount/method returns 409. Quote expires in 30 minutes. No charge until authorized. Check /v1/payment-methods before choosing a method.

tools.name: topup_status
tools.description: Resumes the stored payment when pending. Paid credit is granted exactly once. Do not submit a new payment after a lost response; poll this URL. pending recommends three seconds between reads.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Read spending by computer

tools.name: viewer
tools.description: Create a private one-hour viewer URL

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "machine_create" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
